dimensions.note: The extension holds no credentials and reads no vault. record_router_test stores the tester's userId, a version, phrases and notes; nothing secret. record_build_result still fetches https only.

record_router_test logs the change line every method logs and, like record_build_result, what stops the release when the request isn't released. Logs carry ids, numbers, statuses and the plain-word problems, not emails.

Refusals are DomainErrors in plain words: not the outcome owner (not_allowed), no published build, another version, a phrase not agreed, or one twice (invalid_input/invalid_state). parseBuildResult names v1 and v2 when apiVersion is wrong. results that aren't JSON now fail validation instead of throwing a raw SyntaxError. candidateExtensions, specification and review still JSON.parse text without a catch; that is unchanged from 2026.11.09.2 and outside this release.

Domain tests cover each Released condition both ways: missing router test, not-answered with note, a phrase left out, latest test wins and a failing retest goes back to Building, a newly published version needs a new test, phrases as written, empty matching exactly, blank whenEmpty, v1 can't release but its evidence is shown, owner-only, wrong version, unknown or duplicate phrase, before publishing, and a request saved before router tests. Services and behavior tests run the whole path including a retry and bad JSON. The contract test reads Factory main's v1 and v2 examples (0a0236e). 67 tests pass.
The same build result twice and now the same router test twice change nothing and still write the request to the method output. A new test for a version replaces the last; history keeps every test.

build-result/v2 is read as Factory's contract (factory#139): recipe {id 1–200, phrases 1–50 trimmed, empty trimmed non-blank}. v1 still parses, but under Mark's decision on factory#78 a v1 result can no longer release a request; Factory's -result writes v1 until this version is published and then switches to v2. Requests already Released keep their status; the rule is applied when something new is recorded.
No new files, sockets or timers. record_router_test reads and writes one request through the existing store.
The manifest description, README and ADR-004 name record_router_test and the new Released rule. The archive holds the same files as 2026.11.09.2 with build_result_v1.ts renamed build_result.ts.

record_router_test arguments: version trimmed 1–100, results 1–50 of {phrase trimmed 1–500, outcome enum, note ≤2000}. The v2 reader mirrors Factory's limits and drops unknown fields, as the contract allows.
routerTests grows by one entry per changed test on a request, bounded by how often the owner retests; identical retries add nothing. No data is written outside the request.
Router tests are recorded and read on the request and page; they're never edited in place, a new test replaces the last for its version, as build results work.
recordRouterTest checks permission, then a published current build, then the version, then each phrase, before changing anything.
No new data names: record_router_test writes request-<id> as other methods do.

Only the request's outcome owner can record a router test; builders, reviewers and observers get not_allowed, and someone who can't see the request gets not_found from the existing load. An outcome owner who is a builder may now start building (#45); the role check is still per request.

Both behaviors move to 2026.11.10.1 with no-op upgrade entries; the settings are unchanged. routerTests is optional on stored requests and read as none when absent, so existing data needs no migration.
